record.chaining: The per-second meter composes with object storage for checkpoints: rent a 4090 for the training step, stop it, and keep the dataset on the 20 GiB free netdisk, so idle time costs nothing between runs.
record.limits_note: Nothing throttles: billing is per second from container start to container stop with a CNY 0.01 minimum, so the constraint is money. A 24 GB RTX 4090 at CNY 1.88 an hour exhausts a CNY 100 deposit in about 53 hours, and the account stops when the balance reaches zero.
record.binding_note: Nothing throttles: billing is per second from container start to container stop with a CNY 0.01 minimum, so the constraint is money. A 24 GB RTX 4090 at CNY 1.88 an hour exhausts a CNY 100 deposit in about 53 hours, and the account stops when the balance reaches zero.

identity_cost.detail: The passport route is the one a non-Chinese person can produce. The registration form itself was not read, so the phone requirement is unstated.
